project.title: Store Backroom-to-Shelf Replenishment Optimisation Pilot
project.objective: Design and pilot a standardised process for moving goods from backroom to shelves safely, accurately and on time across one store.
deliverables: Shift-based task allocation and rotation plan
Safety and handling checklist for movers and shelf fillers
Stock accuracy and shelf presentation tracking sheet
Pilot results summary with improvement recommendations
constraints: Pilot must run within one full stock cycle of 21 days
No additional headcount or overtime budget allowed
Must comply with health, safety and food hygiene rules
Backroom space layout cannot be structurally changed
Process must work for both day and evening shifts

risks.risk: Stock replenishment pilot disrupts normal store operations and causes delays.
risks.mitigation: Phase rollout by aisle, schedule trials in lower-traffic hours, and keep a fallback to current process.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with safety or food hygiene during faster loading and filling.
risks.mitigation: Introduce mandatory safety checklist, brief all staff, and spot-check compliance during pilot.

risks.risk: Inaccurate stock records due to process changes and new tracking sheet.
risks.mitigation: Double-check counts for high-rotation items and reconcile discrepancies daily for the pilot period.

risks.risk: Low adoption of new workflow by staff used to existing habits.
risks.mitigation: Involve representatives from movers, shelf fillers and office clerks in design and gather feedback weekly.

themes.why_relevant: Movers handle heavy and sometimes hazardous goods; process must reduce risk of injury and damage.
Office clerks track documents and records; accurate counts and logs are key to evaluating the pilot.
Shelf fillers must keep shelves full, clean and compliant with shelf life and pricing rules.
Different roles and shifts must coordinate loading, moving and filling without bottlenecks.
Damaged goods, missing items or safety incidents must be logged and resolved consistently.

backlog.task: Map current backroom-to-shelf workflow for one pilot aisle
definition_of_done: All steps from truck unloading to shelf filling documented
Roles and handoffs identified for each step
Pain points and delays listed in the workflow doc

backlog.task: Design standard loading and movement sequence for pallets and trolleys
definition_of_done: Sequence defined for at least three main product categories
Weight distribution and equipment capacity considered
Safety officer reviews and approves the sequence

backlog.task: Create safety and hygiene checklist for movers and shelf fillers
definition_of_done: Checklist covers lifting, stacking, food safety and cleaning
Checklist fits on one page and is easy to use on shift
Store operations manager signs off the checklist

backlog.task: Define standard shelf replenishment routine for the pilot aisle
definition_of_done: Routine includes stock rotation and shelf life checks
Steps for changing labels and checking price accuracy defined
Routine tested on one full replenishment cycle

backlog.task: Set up stock accuracy and shelf presentation tracking sheet
definition_of_done: Sheet includes daily counts and shelf condition fields
Columns for incidents and exceptions added
Team trained on how to fill in the sheet

backlog.task: Plan shift-based task allocation and rotation for pilot period
definition_of_done: Allocation covers movers, shelf fillers and office clerks
Rotation avoids overloading any single role or shift
Schedule shared with all involved staff

backlog.task: Pilot new loading and movement sequence on two delivery days
definition_of_done: New sequence used on at least two inbound deliveries
Any issues or delays logged in incident record
Feedback from movers collected and summarised

backlog.task: Pilot new shelf replenishment routine on the selected aisle
definition_of_done: Routine followed for at least five consecutive days
Shelf gaps and mispriced items tracked daily
Before-and-after photos captured for comparison

backlog.task: Implement incident and exception logging procedure
definition_of_done: Simple form created for damaged, missing or unsafe items
Team briefed on when and how to log incidents
At least three sample incidents recorded during pilot

backlog.task: Coordinate cleaning routines around new replenishment schedule
definition_of_done: Cleaning tasks aligned with loading and filling times
No blocked aisles due to overlapping cleaning and loading
Cleaning responsibilities clarified per shift

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot results and propose improvements
definition_of_done: Tracking sheet data summarised for the pilot period
Key issues and successes listed with examples
Three concrete improvement proposals documented

backlog.task: Validate that new process meets safety and hygiene requirements
definition_of_done: Checklist used for at least one full week of shifts
Any non-compliance cases recorded and reviewed
Health and safety officer confirms compliance

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current workflow, main pain points and pilot scope for one aisle.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to describe how backroom-to-shelf works today.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which aisle and product categories will be included in the pilot.
Agree on the start date and duration of the pilot within the 21-day window.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate the new loading, movement and shelf routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing first draft of loading sequence and shelf routine for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard loading and movement sequence for the pilot.
Approve the shelf replenishment routine steps for the pilot aisle.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in safety, hygiene and incident logging practices for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Post with draft safety checklist and incident log asking for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final version of the safety and hygiene checklist to use.
Agree on when and how staff must fill in the incident and exception log.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate daily execution, tracking and quick fixes during the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: First day of pilot with a message asking for daily updates and issues.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide how often to update the tracking sheet and share quick status in the channel.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on next steps and improvements.
threads_plan.trigger: End-of-pilot message sharing summary of tracking data and incidents.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which process changes to keep and whether to extend the pilot to more aisles.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in at shift change with what was done, issues and plan for next shift.
Mid-pilot review at the end of week one to adjust routines and allocation if needed.
End-of-day incident summary post linking any new entries in the incident log.
Final pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
